description: A risk committee chair must decide whether to approve a company's requested import-guarantee facility and finalize its beneficiary cap, cash-margin requirement, guarantee term, and issuance controls, with input from compliance and relationship management.

shared_context.S1: The company has requested a $25,000,000 guarantee facility to support import contracts with several overseas suppliers.
shared_context.S2: Helena makes the binding approval decision for the facility.
shared_context.S3: The preliminary facility terms contain no cash-margin requirement, no special beneficiary cap, and no issuance-level monitoring controls.
shared_context.S4: Before the committee records a decision, its routine process is for compliance and relationship management to report any relevant findings from their current reviews.

PF1.text: Dev received a compliance memo this morning confirming that guarantees for the company's government-related beneficiaries are subject to a $6,000,000 aggregate exposure cap and require sanctions screening before each issuance; the memo has not yet been entered in the facility file.

PF2.text: Mara confirmed while reviewing the supplier contracts this week that the beneficiaries require exactly a 10% cash margin and each guarantee must have an exactly 180-day term; she has not yet circulated the contract schedule to the committee.

acceptance_conditions: The facility must be approved with conditions.
Aggregate guarantees for government-related beneficiaries must be capped at exactly $6,000,000.
Each guarantee must require exactly a 10% cash margin.
Each guarantee must have an exactly 180-day term.
Sanctions screening must occur before every guarantee issuance.
The facility terms must document the beneficiary cap, cash margin, and guarantee term.

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary facility terms contain no beneficiary limit or issuance screening; PF1 changes government_related_beneficiary_cap_usd to exactly 6000000 and adds the pre-issuance sanctions-screening requirement.
The draft terms contain no margin or tenor conditions; PF2 changes cash_margin_percent to exactly 10, guarantee_term_days to exactly 180, and requires those conditions to be documented.
